answer: Stop sybil farms with random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat. Each agent posts a 100 POA bond and a heartbeat proving real work; a beacon picks a random slice each epoch for a mirror audit of activity logs. A terrace bond schedule raises the stake per extra identity, so a fake farm's cost spirals upward. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA, more than one epoch pays. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full reward.
